subject.title: feat: let a clerk mark stock status and hide out-of-stock products

question: Should the new persistent Store listing setting and exported storefront-listing API be accepted as supported Commerce contract?
rationale: The repository policy reserves merges for explicit human approval, and this feature adds both a persisted setting and public exports.

options.title: Approve the contract
options.body: Accept the Store-level hide-out-of-stock setting and its public listing exports, with missing settings continuing to default to Show.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Request a focused revision that keeps the behavior internal or adjusts the exported API before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the contract
recommendation.body: Accept the Store-level hide-out-of-stock setting and its public listing exports, with missing settings continuing to default to Show.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the implementation and the related catalog/availability work in the supplied history.
